answers.b: Using a pretrained model for a new related task
answers.c: Using only test data for training

explanations.a: Incorrect because transfer learning reuses knowledge from an already trained model instead of starting from zero.
explanations.b: Correct because transfer learning applies knowledge learned from a source dataset to improve learning on a target dataset.
explanations.c: Incorrect because test data is not used for training in standard machine learning practice.

questions.question: 2. Why is Transfer Learning useful for small datasets?

answers.a: It increases the number of classes automatically
answers.b: It removes the need for training
answers.c: It reduces overfitting by using pretrained features

explanations.a: Incorrect because transfer learning does not change the number of classes automatically.
explanations.b: Incorrect because training is still required at least for the final classification layers.
explanations.c: Correct because pretrained CNNs already contain useful feature extractors, helping the model generalize better even with less data.
explanations.d: Incorrect because transfer learning does not perform data-type conversion.

questions.question: 3. Which large dataset is commonly used to pretrain deep CNN models?

explanations.a: Incorrect because MNIST is small and does not provide rich features for large-scale object recognition.
explanations.b: Correct because ImageNet contains millions of images and is widely used to pretrain CNN backbones.
explanations.c: Incorrect because it is a smaller dataset usually used as a target dataset for fine-tuning.
explanations.d: Incorrect because IMDB is a text dataset, not an image dataset.

questions.question: 4. Which of the following is a lightweight pretrained CNN model?

explanations.a: Correct because MobileNet is designed for efficiency and low computational cost.
explanations.b: Incorrect because VGG19 is heavy and has a large number of parameters.
explanations.c: Incorrect because it is more complex and computationally expensive.
explanations.d: Incorrect because it is not as lightweight and efficient as MobileNet for modern devices.

explanations.a: Incorrect because freezing does not remove layers; it only stops their parameters from updating.
explanations.b: Correct because frozen layers keep pretrained weights fixed and do not learn during fine-tuning.
explanations.c: Incorrect because freezing does not involve increasing learning rate.
explanations.d: Incorrect because freezing typically affects early layers, not only the input layer.

questions.question: 6. The early layers of a CNN generally learn:

answers.c: Basic features like edges and textures

explanations.a: Incorrect because complex patterns are learned in deeper layers.
explanations.b: Incorrect because CNN layers learn visual patterns, not text or names.
explanations.c: Correct because early convolution layers extract low-level visual features.
explanations.d: Incorrect because CNN filters are trained to learn useful patterns, not random noise.

questions.question: 7. Fine-tuning in Transfer Learning refers to:

answers.a: Training the entire CNN model from scratch
answers.b: Retraining some pretrained layers on the target dataset
answers.c: Using only validation data for training
answers.d: Converting CNN into an SVM model

explanations.a: Incorrect because fine-tuning starts from pretrained weights.
explanations.b: Correct because fine-tuning updates selected layers so the model adapts to the new task.
explanations.c: Incorrect because validation data is meant for evaluation, not training.
explanations.d: Incorrect because fine-tuning does not change the architecture into a different algorithm.

questions.question: 9. Which layer is commonly used to reduce spatial dimensions in CNNs?

explanations.a: Correct because pooling reduces width and height while keeping important information.
explanations.b: Incorrect because dense layers work on flattened vectors, not spatial reduction.
explanations.c: Incorrect because dropout prevents overfitting but does not reduce spatial dimensions directly.
explanations.d: Incorrect because Softmax is used for classification output, not dimension reduction.

questions.question: 10. What is a major risk when transferring from an unrelated source dataset?

explanations.a: Incorrect because faster training is not guaranteed if the features are not useful.
explanations.b: Correct because transferring irrelevant knowledge can reduce target performance.
explanations.c: Incorrect because transfer learning does not clean the dataset.
explanations.d: Incorrect because no method guarantees perfect accuracy.
